(also written मिस्र्, properly Nom. fr. मिश्र below) cl. 10. P. (Dhātup. xxxv, 67) मिश्रयति (or मिश्रापयति, Vop.), to mix, mingle, blend, combine (‘with’, instr.), KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.;
to add, Sūryas.
[cf. Gk. μίσγω, μίγνυμι.; Lat. miscere; Slav. měsiti; Lith. mìsti, maisztas; Germ. misken, mischen; Angl.Sax. miscian; Eng. mix.]
See मिश्र्, p. 817, col. 3.
